#### Module A — Azure OpenAI / Foundry `GA` `AzureActivity (built-in)`

Rules deployed: **AIGS-CD001** (RAI Policy Modified) · **AIGS-CD005** (AI Resource Diagnostics Changed)

Hunts deployed: **AIGS-Hunt-AzureOpenAIRAIChanges** (Module A)

ASIM: `imAuditEvent — native` · Watchlists: `AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies`, `AIGS_ApprovedModels`

> **AIGS-CD001** fires on `raiPolicies/write|delete` (content filter policy changes). **AIGS-CD005** fires on `diagnosticSettings/write|delete` on CognitiveServices resources (audit continuity). Hunt queries provide broader historical coverage — see hunt sections below. Model deployment events are covered by the Module E hunt (**AIGS-Hunt-AIModelDeploymentChanges**) which also surfaces Azure OpenAI/Foundry deployment activity.","style":"success"},"name":"soc-modA-header"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// CONTROL: AIGS-CD001  MODULE: A — Azure OpenAI / Foundry
// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native  (AzureActivity maps natively to _Im_AuditEvent)
// Detects ARM management-plane writes to Azure OpenAI RAI (content filter) policies.
// Source: AzureActivity — built-in connector, no additional deployment required.
// Watchlist: AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies (baseline authority for approved policy names)
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > {TimeRange:start}
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/raiPolicies/write'
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ResourceGroup,
    Resource,
    Caller,
    CallerIpAddress,
    OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatus,
    ActivitySubstatus,
    Properties=tostring(Properties)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc","size":0,"title":"AIGS-CD001 — Content Filter Policy Changes [AzureActivity]","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["{Workspace}"],"visualization":"table","noDataMessage":"No content filter policy write operations detected. If Azure OpenAI resources exist, no policy changes occurred in the time range. Absence of events does NOT confirm compliant state — run the AIGS-CD005 hunt to assess posture gaps.","noDataMessageStyle":3},"name":"soc-cd001"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// CONTROL: AIGS-CD005  MODULE: A — Azure OpenAI / Foundry
// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native  (AzureActivity maps natively to _Im_AuditEvent)
// Detects successful write or delete of Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings
// on Microsoft.CognitiveServices resources (Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry accounts).
// A delete removes audit-log forwarding entirely (HIGH); a write may reduce logged categories (MEDIUM).
// Source: AzureActivity — built-in connector, no additional deployment required.
// Response: AIGS-Auto-001-RestoreDiagnostics (approval-gated restoration).
let DiagOps = dynamic([
    'microsoft.insights/diagnosticsettings/write',
    'microsoft.insights/diagnosticsettings/delete'
]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > {TimeRange:start}
| where tolower(OperationNameValue) in (DiagOps)
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| where tolower(_ResourceId) contains 'microsoft.cognitiveservices'
| extend
    AccountName   = tostring(extract(@'/accounts/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    SettingName   = tostring(extract(@'/diagnosticsettings/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    OperationType = iff(tolower(OperationNameValue) has 'delete', 'Delete', 'Write')
| extend SeverityIndicator = case(
    OperationType == 'Delete', '🔴 HIGH — Diagnostic setting deleted; audit-log forwarding may be interrupted',
    OperationType == 'Write',  '🟡 MEDIUM — Diagnostic setting written; validate log categories and destinations unchanged',
    'INFO — Review required')
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    SeverityIndicator,
    OperationType,
    OperationNameValue,
    _ResourceId,
    AccountName,
    SettingName,
    Caller,
    CallerIpAddress,
    SubscriptionId,
    ResourceGroup,
    ActivityStatusValue,
    CorrelationId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc","size":0,"title":"AIGS-CD005 — AI Resource Diagnostics Changed [AzureActivity]","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["{Workspace}"],"visualization":"table","noDataMessage":"No diagnostic-settings changes on CognitiveServices resources in the selected time range. Absence of events does NOT confirm compliant state — verify all AI resources have active diagnostic settings via Azure Portal.","noDataMessageStyle":4},"name":"soc-cd005"},{"type":1,"content":{"json":"---
#### Module A — Hunt Queries `AzureActivity (built-in)`

Two hunt queries are deployed for Module A. Both use AzureActivity (no additional connector required). Hunts do not create alerts automatically — run on demand for investigation, baseline seeding, and compliance review.

> Run the full hunt query files for watchlist-joined analysis with `AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies` and `AIGS_ApprovedModels`.","style":"info"},"name":"soc-hunt-header"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// HUNT: AIGS-Hunt-AzureOpenAIRAIChanges  MODULE: A — Azure OpenAI / Foundry
// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native
// Returns all raiPolicy write/delete events for historical investigation and AIGS-CD001 baseline seeding.
// Workbook view: raw events. Run full hunt file for watchlist-joined analysis.
let RaiPolicyOps = dynamic([
    'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/raipolicies/write',
    'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/raipolicies/delete'
]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > {TimeRange:start}
| where tolower(OperationNameValue) in (RaiPolicyOps)
| extend
    AccountName   = tostring(extract(@'/accounts/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    PolicyTarget  = tostring(extract(@'/raipolicies/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    OperationType = iff(tolower(OperationNameValue) has 'delete', 'Delete', 'Write')
| extend RiskSignal = case(
    OperationType == 'Delete' and ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success', '🔴 HIGH — Successful delete; validate policy still present',
    OperationType == 'Delete',                                       '🟡 MEDIUM — Failed delete attempt; review caller intent',
    OperationType == 'Write' and ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success',  '🟡 MEDIUM — Successful write; validate policy values unchanged',
    '🟢 LOW — Review')
| project TimeGenerated, RiskSignal, OperationType, ActivityStatusValue,
    AccountName, PolicyTarget, Caller, CallerIpAddress, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup
| order by TimeGenerated desc","size":0,"title":"AIGS-Hunt-AzureOpenAIRAIChanges — RAI Policy Change History [AzureActivity]","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["{Workspace}"],"visualization":"table","noDataMessage":"No RAI policy changes in the selected time range. Widen the range or confirm Azure OpenAI resources exist with AzureActivity diagnostic settings enabled.","noDataMessageStyle":3},"name":"soc-hunt-raichanges"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// HUNT: AIGS-Hunt-AIModelDeploymentChanges  MODULE: E — Azure General
// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native
// Returns successful CognitiveServices deployments/write events for investigation.
// Workbook view: raw deployment events. Run full hunt file for watchlist-joined analysis.
// Note: AIGS-AM001 analytic rule has not been authored — no automated alert fires.
// Note: This hunt also surfaces Azure OpenAI/Foundry deployment activity (AzureActivity is shared).
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > {TimeRange:start}
| where tolower(OperationNameValue) == 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/deployments/write'
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| extend
    AccountName    = tostring(extract(@'/accounts/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    DeploymentName = tostring(extract(@'/deployments/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId)))
| project TimeGenerated, AccountName, DeploymentName, Caller, CallerIpAddress,
    OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc","size":0,"title":"AIGS-Hunt-AIModelDeploymentChanges — Model Deployment Events (Module E Hunt) [AzureActivity]","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["{Workspace}"],"visualization":"table","noDataMessage":"No AI model deployment events in the selected time range. If Azure OpenAI/Foundry resources exist, verify AzureActivity is ingesting CognitiveServices ARM events. Note: AIGS-AM001 analytic rule has not been authored — this is a hunt view only.","noDataMessageStyle":3},"name":"soc-hunt-deployments"},{"type":1,"content":{"json":"---
#### Module E — Azure General `GA` `AzureActivity (built-in)`

Hunt deployed: **AIGS-Hunt-AIModelDeploymentChanges** (Module E; also surfaces Azure OpenAI/Foundry deployment events — see hunt section above)

⚠️ **AIGS-AM001 analytic rule has not been authored.** The query below provides a SOC view of model deployment events. No alert fires automatically until the rule is authored and deployed. Absence of events does NOT confirm compliant state.

**Audience:** AI Platform Admin / DevOps / Solution Admin

Module health status, connector availability, ASIM promotion declarations, and core table telemetry freshness. Use **Module** and **Maturity** filters.

> **isfuzzy=true pattern:** All optional-table health checks use `union isfuzzy=true`. Missing tables are silently skipped and return zero events, surfacing as **Not Configured**. No query will error due to an absent optional table.","style":"info"},"name":"health-header"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// Platform Health — module status using isfuzzy=true for optional tables.
// Tables absent from workspace return 0 and surface as Not Configured.
// isfuzzy=true: missing table legs are silently skipped; no query errors.
let modA = toscalar(
    AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where OperationNameValue has 'cognitiveservices' | count
);
let modB = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (AgentsInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize n=count()),
        (print n=long(0))
    | summarize max(n)
);
let modC = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (CopilotActivity | where Workload != 'SecurityCopilot' | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize n=count()),
        (print n=long(0))
    | summarize max(n)
);
let modD = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize n=count()),
        (print n=long(0))
    | summarize max(n)
);
let modE = toscalar(
    AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where OperationNameValue has 'cognitiveservices'
          and OperationNameValue has 'deployments'
    | count
);
let modF = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (OfficeActivity | where OfficeWorkload == 'Purview' | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize n=count()),
        (print n=long(0))
    | summarize max(n)
);
let modG = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (CopilotActivity | where Workload == 'SecurityCopilot' | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize n=count()),
        (print n=long(0))
    | summarize max(n)
);

Missing connectors, telemetry, and active baselines are reported as not configured rather than compliant.; dataTypesDependencies=System.Object[]; dataConnectorsDependencies=System.Object[]; previewImagesFileNames=System.Object[]; version=1.0.0; title=AI Governance Solution; templateRelativePath=AIGovernanceSolution.json; subtitle=Governance coverage, configuration drift, and response readiness; provider=x3nc0n}.description

Detects successful write or delete operations against Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/raiPolicies
on resources and policies explicitly tracked as Active in the AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies watchlist.

FAIL-CLOSED: If AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies contains no Active entries, this rule produces zero
results. An empty or template-only watchlist does not trigger alerts. Populate the watchlist with
at least one Status=Active row before this rule will fire.

Results are labeled drift candidates requiring analyst investigation. This rule DOES NOT confirm
that content filter values were weakened or removed — AzureActivity carries the ARM operation event
but not the before-state policy body. PB-AUTO-01 cannot restore RAI policies from this alert;
response is notify and investigate only.

Analyst action: Verify current raiPolicy state via Azure Portal or the REST API
(GET .../providers/Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/{name}/raiPolicies) before escalating.

ASIM: native AzureActivity → imAuditEvent (_Im_AuditEvent, ASIM Audit Event schema); optional
imAuditEvent mapping available. No custom parser required; no false ASIM claim.

Module:   A — Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry
Control:  AIGS-CD001
Domain:   Configuration Drift (CD)
Response: PB-NOTIFY-01 (notify and investigate only — PB-AUTO-01 cannot restore RAI policies;
          AzureActivity lacks before-state policy body)
Baseline: AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies watchlist (itemsSearchKey: ItemKey; match on AccountName + PolicyName)
MCSB:     NS-1 (Establish network segmentation boundaries), IM-1 (Use centralised identity)
NIST AI RMF: GOVERN-1.1, MANAGE-2.2

properties.description:
Detects successful write or delete operations against Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings
on Microsoft.CognitiveServices resources (Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry accounts) that are
explicitly tracked as Active in the AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies watchlist.

FAIL-CLOSED: If AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies contains no Active entries, this rule produces zero
results. Scope is derived from the AccountName field of the content-filter baseline — accounts
in that Active baseline are the approved AI resource set monitored by this rule.

Rationale for using AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies as resource scope: This watchlist tracks approved
CognitiveServices accounts with documented governance expectations. Restricting CD005 to this
scope avoids alerting on dev/test resources and ensures diagnostic-settings changes are only
surfaced for explicitly governed AI resources. The watchlist does not define expected diagnostic
log categories or workspace destinations; this rule scopes to the resource, not to specific
settings values. PB-AUTO-01 is NOT referenced as a restore action because AzureActivity does
not carry the before-state diagnostic settings body — no baseline-safe automatic restoration
is possible from this alert.

A delete operation removes audit-log forwarding entirely — high-severity indicator.
A write operation may represent a legitimate change or reduction in log categories.

ASIM: native AzureActivity → imAuditEvent (_Im_AuditEvent, ASIM Audit Event schema); optional
imAuditEvent mapping available. No custom parser required; no false ASIM claim.

Module:   A — Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry
Control:  AIGS-CD005
Domain:   Configuration Drift (CD)
Response: PB-NOTIFY-01 (notify and investigate only — PB-AUTO-01 not applicable;
          before-state diagnostic settings body unavailable from AzureActivity)
Baseline: AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies watchlist (AccountName field; Status=Active)
MCSB:     LT-3 (Enable logging for security investigation), LT-4 (Enable network logging)
NIST AI RMF: GOVERN-1.3, MAP-5.1

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Returns successful model deployment write operations on Microsoft.CognitiveServices accounts
over the selected lookback period, cross-referenced against the AIGS_ApprovedModels watchlist.
Flags deployments where the deployment name is not present in the approved models baseline.

LOCATION VALIDATION LIMITATION: AzureActivity does not contain resource location (region).
Region enforcement is not possible from AzureActivity alone and requires Azure Resource Graph
correlation outside Sentinel KQL. ResourceGroup is NOT a reliable region proxy.
This hunt surfaces deployment change evidence only; it cannot validate region compliance.

When the AIGS_ApprovedModels watchlist is absent, all successful deployment write events
are surfaced to support initial baseline seeding.

NOTE: This hunt does not assess compliance. Without the AIGS_ApprovedModels watchlist configured,
no baseline comparison is performed — results are change evidence only, never a compliance
determination. Baseline comparison is unavailable when the watchlist is absent.

CAVEAT: Deployment name (from ARM resource path) is used as model proxy. The actual model name
lives in the ARM request body (Properties field), which is not formally documented in the
AzureActivity schema reference. Deployment names may be custom aliases; analyst confirmation
against Azure Resource Manager is required when this hunt flags a deployment.

This hunt complements AIGS-AM001 (Unauthorized AI Model Deployment) by providing a broader
historical view across the full lookback window for threat hunting and compliance review.

ASIM: native AzureActivity → imAuditEvent (_Im_AuditEvent, ASIM Audit Event schema);
optional imAuditEvent mapping available. No custom parser required; no false ASIM claim.

Module:   E — Azure General / Model Governance
Control:  AIGS-AM001 (reference)
Domain:   Audit Monitoring (AM)
Default lookback: 14 days (adjust LookbackPeriod as needed)

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Returns all successful and failed write/delete operations against
Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/raiPolicies over the selected lookback period.
Use this hunt to reconstruct the history of Responsible AI (RAI) / content-filter policy
changes on Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry accounts, identify unexpected callers,
and seed or validate the AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies baseline watchlist.

Results show individual events ordered by time, followed by a per-account change summary.
No watchlist is required; all raiPolicy activity is surfaced regardless of baseline state.

optional imAuditEvent mapping available. No custom parser required; no false ASIM claim.
